notes.title: 🔮 Meet the Crew [04/04] - Crystal Bowie
notes.content:
Hello Space Adventurers,

With Cobra back into action, it doesn’t take long for his old enemies to show up. Especially the Space Pirates Guild.
Crystal Bowie in particular stands out among them. This ruthless assassin is determined to hunt down Cobra and leave him dead once and for all.

notes.title: 🦋 Meet the Crew [03/04] - Jane Royal
notes.content:
Hello Space Adventurers,

A fearsome bounty hunter, Jane is the embodiment of float like a butterfly 🦋 sting like a bee 🐝 Something Cobra will learn at his expense… But, ever so the gentleman, he will gladly join forces with Jane to help her find and save her sisters.

notes.title: 🤖 Meet the Crew [02/04] - Lady Armaroid
notes.content:
Hello Space Adventurers,

Great friends make the best adventures ⭐
 
In addition to being a fearless fighter, Lady Armaroid is Cobra’s loyal partner. With a living metal body, she's ready to stand by his side no matter the danger they’ll face in Space Adventure Cobra - The Awakening!
